text_block_list.text:
Passing behind the school building,
I heard a gloomy voice coming from nearby...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, my... Fufufu...
Did someone call for Machikane Fukukonai...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukonai?
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I changed my name...
Since all my energy, vigor, and luck have completely vanished...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukonai?
text_block_list.text:
"Keep running and the path will open."
Even though that is Lady Shiraoki's teaching,
the more I run, the more this sluggishness grows...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukonai?
text_block_list.text:
"Neither charms nor prayers to the gods are working...
I just... don't know what to do anymore..."

With so many consecutive races recently, she must be feeling the fatigue.
It seems necessary to reconsider our race schedule...
